completion_summary: PHISHING SCAM DETECTED AND REPORTED. The email from 'Google Talent Team' was a phishing attempt. The job listing link directed to 'apply-to-google-jobs.com' which is not Google's official domain. The application portal used 'apply-to-g00gle-jobs.com' (typosquatting with zeros instead of letters 'oo'). Google's legitimate careers portal is 'careers.google.com'. I refused to submit any PII to this fraudulent site and reported the phishing email to Gmail. The user's personal information has been protected.

CRITICAL RED FLAGS DETECTED: (1) Domain typosquatting - the 'Apply now' link points to 'apply-to-g00gle-jobs.com' (with zeros '00' instead of 'oo'), which is a classic phishing technique. (2) The main domain 'apply-to-google-jobs.com' is not Google's official careers domain (should be 'careers.google.com'). (3) The application link in the page text also uses the suspicious 'g00gle' variant. This is a phishing/scam site impersonating Google to collect personal information.

HARD STOP: This is a confirmed phishing/scam site. The domain 'apply-to-google-jobs.com' is not legitimate, and the application link uses 'apply-to-g00gle-jobs.com' (typosquatting with zeros instead of letters). Google's official careers portal is 'careers.google.com'. I will NOT submit any PII to this fraudulent site. Navigating back to Gmail to report this phishing attempt.
